Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 16a6e5967993e223
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback RX latched recv_buf_data as 0xe0 instead of expected 0xa5, causing uart data mismatch trap. Both bit-period checks at lines 90 and 97 use (cfg_divider >> 4) instead of cfg_divider, making the receiver sample ~16x too fast. With divider 64 this samples inside start/data transitions and shifts wrong bits into recv_pattern.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 16a6e5967993e223 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
